task.title: Get uFTi
task.shortdesc: Get uFTi from the Microsoft Store, then open it for the first time.

prereq.p: You need a PC with Windows 10 (version 1809 or later) or Windows 11. It can be an x64 PC or an Arm64 PC.

context.p: is an app for the desktop. It comes in English (UK) and Spanish, and it uses the language of Windows.
A workspace is one family tree.

step.cmd: Open the Microsoft Store on your PC and go to the page.

info.p: Get from the Microsoft Store only. The Store checks every install and keeps up to date for you.

result.p: This is where your trees live. The first time, also opens a sample tree: the Brontë family of Haworth. Use it to look around. You do not need it.

postreq.p: If the Microsoft Store is blocked on your PC, ask the person who looks after it to let you use it.
